services.p: Residential moves across Vancouver, WA, Portland, OR, and the surrounding metro. Packing, loading, transportation, unloading, unpacking — all included, no hidden fees.
Interstate relocations from the Pacific Northwest. USDOT-licensed (#4232069) and fully insured for cross-state moves of any size.
Office and commercial relocations in Vancouver and Portland with minimal downtime. Equipment, furniture, and sensitive documents handled safely and on schedule.
We pack everything — every room, every drawer, every fragile item. You keep working, we handle the boxes. Best for busy professionals, last-minute moves, and families with young kids.

ctaBeat.headline: Make the next move the easy one.

steps.label: Step 01
steps.title: Get a Free Estimate
steps.body: Tell us your move details — pickup, drop-off, date, anything fragile — and we'll send back an honest, all-in quote. No phone tag, no obligations.

steps.label: Step 02
steps.title: We Show Up Ready
steps.body: On move day the crew rolls up on time with the right-size truck, padding, dollies, shrink-wrap, and the materials it takes to start working in the first ten minutes.

steps.label: Step 03
steps.title: We Pack & Load
steps.body: Furniture wrapped, boxes stacked, electronics and fragiles boxed with care. Everything secured in the truck so nothing shifts on the road.

steps.label: Step 04
steps.title: Delivery & Setup
steps.body: We unload at your new place, reassemble the furniture we disassembled, and put boxes in the rooms you want them. The job ends with you settled in, not at the curb.

items.question: How much does a local move cost in Vancouver, WA?
items.answer: Our rate is $125/hour. Most studio or 1-bedroom moves take 2-3 hours, a 2-3 bedroom home takes 4-6 hours. 3-hour minimum for all moves. No charge for stairs.

items.question: How long does a move take?
items.answer: It depends on the size: a studio or 1-bedroom typically takes 2-3 hours, a 2-3 bedroom home 4-6 hours. Larger moves may take a full day.

items.question: What’s included in the hourly rate?
items.answer: The moving truck, fuel, all equipment (dollies, blankets, straps), and our professional movers. No hidden fees.

items.question: Do you serve Portland, OR?
items.answer: Yes. We’re based in Vancouver, WA and serve the entire Portland metro — including Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard, and Gresham.

items.question: Do you offer packing services?
items.answer: Yes. Tape, shrink wrap, mattress covers, and boxes are available at additional cost. You’re welcome to use your own materials.

items.question: Do you disassemble and reassemble furniture?
items.answer: Yes — bed frames and basic furniture disassembly/reassembly is included at no extra charge.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. GOAT Movers is fully licensed (USDOT #4232069, MC #1637475) and insured. Active interstate authority through FMCSA.

items.question: Do you charge for travel time?
items.answer: Travel time is billed at our standard hourly rate — from our location to yours and back. No hidden surcharges.

items.question: How do you protect TVs and electronics?
items.answer: Specialized TV boxes and padding. For large screens, we offer custom crating.
